back: Proving that a user, device or message is who or what it claims to be before access is given.
Give each user only the access rights needed for their work, usually through groups.
Something you know (password), have (token or phone) and are (biometrics). Two-factor needs two different kinds.
Checks packets against rules, in order, and allows or blocks them; the first matching rule decides. A final rule can deny all else.
Scan files and programs for known malware and suspicious behaviour, then remove or quarantine it; keep the definitions up to date.
Signed with the sender's private key and checked with the public key; shows who sent it and that it was not altered.
A separate copy of data, ideally off-site, used to restore data after loss, damage or an attack.
Chance of guessing = number of attempts allowed ÷ number of possible combinations.
Change default passwords, switch off unused services, remove unused accounts and apply updates.
